blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: On-policy Self-distillation (OPSD) has proven effective for post-training large language models by constructing a teacher conditioned on privileged references. However, existing approaches keep the teacher fixed either throughout training by consistently exposing it to the full reference, or within each response by adaptively varying partial reference exposure only across responses. In this paper, we argue that neither of them is sufficient. Instead, every token needs its own teacher, as the teacher preference can vary token by token within the same response. Through a teacher-intervention pilot study, we validate that the teacher preference differs across tokens, and reveal that a preferred teacher can be identified for each token through majority voting and KL-based selection. Motivated by these findings, we propose Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-Distillation (MTA-OPSD), the first token-level adaptive OPSD method. Our method constructs a multi-teacher pool consisting of candidate teachers, and enables every token to adaptively select its preferred teacher during training. Experiments with Qwen3 models on mathematical reasoning tasks show that MTA-OPSD consistently outperforms existing OPSD approaches with an average gain of up to $+5.9$ over the base model, highlighting the importance of adapting teacher supervision at the token level. The code is available at https://github.com/xingzhejun/MTA-OPSD.
blocks.zh: 实践证明,通过建立以特准推荐为条件的教师,政策上的自我消化(OPSD)对于培训后大型语言模式是有效的。 然而,现行做法要么使教师在整个培训过程中保持固定,始终将教师置于全面参考之下,要么在每项答复中仅通过在答复中不同程度的局部参考接触加以调整。 在这份文件中,我们争辩说,两者都不够。 相反,每个标志都需要自己的老师,因为老师的偏好可以在同一反应中逐一地改变。 通过一项教师干预试点研究,我们确认教师的偏好在不同标志上有所不同,并表明可以通过多数投票和以KL为基础的选择,为每个标志物确定一个偏好教师。 基于这些调查结果,我们提出了多教师适应政策自我调整(MTA-OPSD),这是第一个象征性的适应性OPSD方法。 我们的方法构建了一个由候选教师组成的多教师人才库,使每一个标志都能在培训期间适应性地选择其偏好教师。 使用Qwen3模型进行数学推理任务的实验表明,MTA-OPSD一直比现有的OPSD方法表现优于基础模型,平均收益最高可达5.9美元,凸显了在象征层面调整教师监管的重要性. 该代码可在https://github.com/xingzhejun/MTA-OPSD上查阅.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: On-policy Self-distillation (OPSD) ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; Hübotter et al., 2026 ; Shenfeld et al., 2026 ; Cui et al., 2026 ) has emerged as a promising paradigm for post-training large language models (LLMs), showing superiority over other post-training paradigms like Supervised Fine-tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) (e.g., GRPO ( Guo et al., 2025 ) ). In OPSD, the same model serves as both student and teacher. The student generates rollout responses, while the teacher provides supervision with access to privileged references, such as reference solutions. Compared with RLVR, OPSD provides dense token-level learning signals beyond sparse outcome rewards. Compared with SFT, it trains on trajectories sampled by the student itself, mitigating the exposure bias ( Bengio et al., 2015 ) .
blocks.zh: 政策上的自我抑制(OPSD)(赵等,2026;Hübotter等,2026;Shenfeld等,2026;Cui等,2026;Cui等)已成为培训后大型语言模式(LLMs)的有希望范例,显示出优于其他培训后模式,如监督精细调整(SFT)和可验证奖励强化学习(RLVR)(如GRPO(Guo等,2025年))。 在OPSD中,同一模式同时担任学生和教师. 学生产生推广响应,而教师提供监督,提供获得特权的参考,如参考解决方案. 相较于RLVR,OPSD提供密集的符号级学习信号,超越了稀少的结果奖励. 与SFT相比,它就学生自己所采样的轨迹进行训练,减轻了接触偏差(Bengio等,2015年).

blocks.en: Despite these advantages, recent studies ( Kim et al., 2026 ; Kaur et al., 2026 ; Harne et al., 2026 ; Armandpour et al., 2026 ) reveal that OPSD can also suffer from degraded reasoning performance, which stems from the highly informative references exposed to the teacher. It may induce overly sharp teacher distributions, producing supervision that is poorly aligned with the student’s learning dynamics (e.g., suppressing uncertainty ( Kim et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) ). A line of work ( Tan and Hong, 2026 ; Han et al., 2026b ; Yang et al., 2026c ) has attempted to address this student-teacher mismatch through adaptive reference exposure. Rather than providing the teacher with the complete reference, it adjusts how much of the reference the teacher receives based on the student’s learning dynamics, such as the student-teacher gap. However, these methods adapt at the response level. Although reference exposure may vary across responses, it remains fixed across tokens within each response. In other words, all tokens in a rollout are supervised by the same teacher.
blocks.zh: 尽管有这些优势,但最近的研究 (Kim等,2026;Kaur等,2026;Harne等,2026;Armandpour等,2026)揭示了OPSD也可能有退化的推理性能,这来源于向老师曝光的高度翔实的引用. 它可能诱发过于尖锐的教师分布,产生与学生学习动态不相适应的监督(如抑制不确定性(Kim等,2026;张等,2026. 有一行工作(Tan and Hong, 2026;Han等, 2026b;Yang等, 2026c)试图通过适应性参考曝光来解决这种学生-教师不匹配的问题. 它不向教师提供完整的参考,而是根据学生的学习动态,如学生与教师的差距,调整教师获得的参考数量。 然而,这些方法在应对层面有所适应。 尽管参考接触可能因答复而异,但在每个答复中,参照接触仍然固定在符号之间。 换句话说,推出时的所有标志都由同一位老师监督.

blocks.en: In this paper, we challenge this consensus by arguing:
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们对这一共识提出质疑,认为:

blocks.en: The adaptive teacher should operate at the token level, because every token requires its own dedicated teacher.
blocks.zh: 适应性教师应该以象征性水平运作,因为每一个象征都需要自己的专心致志的教师.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Token-level learning signals induced by different teachers for the same response. Teachers agree at some positions but provide opposing signals at others, motivating token-level teacher selection. Additional details on this visualization are provided in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 图1:不同教师为相同响应而诱发的托肯级学习信号. 教师在某些职位上表示同意,但在其他职位上却发出相反的信号,鼓励象征性的教师遴选。 关于这种可视化的进一步详情见附录A。

blocks.en: A teacher that provides useful guidance at one token may be less suitable at another, even within the same response. Rather than treating it with the same teacher, each token in the response merits consideration with its own preferred teacher. As illustrated in Figure 1 , when different teachers are applied to the same response, they can provide similar learning signals for some tokens but disagree on the direction of supervision for others. This suggests that not only each response, but also each token, may have distinct teacher preferences.
blocks.zh: 在一个方面提供有用指导的教师在另一个方面可能不太合适,即使在同一反应范围内也是如此。 答复中的每个符号都值得由自己偏爱的老师来考虑,而不是用同一个老师来处理。 如图1所示,当不同的教师被应用于同一反应时,他们可以为某些符号提供类似的学习信号,但对其他符号的监督方向有分歧. 这表明,不仅每个答复,而且每个符号,都可能具有不同的教师偏好。

blocks.en: While some prior work ( Wang et al., 2026c ; Hao et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026b ; Ke et al., 2026 ; Wei et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026 ; Han et al., 2026a ) has explored token selection for post-training (e.g., focusing solely on high-entropy tokens ( Wang et al., 2026c ) ), how to validate our claim is challenging, and how to adaptively identify the preferred teacher for each token remains unexplored. To answer these, we conduct a teacher-intervention pilot study ( Section 4 ) to quantify the token-level teacher preference. As shown in Figure 2 , we preserve a student-generated prefix, allow a candidate teacher to generate a short continuation at a selected token position, and then return control to the student to complete the response. The accuracy gain from this “student-teacher-student” relay over pure student generation serves as a proxy for the teacher preference at that token position. A large gain implies a compatible teacher for that position, while a small gain suggests the opposite. Interestingly, the results are simple, yet clear and compelling. First, teacher preferences differ across tokens, even within the same response. Second, at the token level, majority voting yields a subset of reliable teachers, and the preferred teacher always exhibits a large student-teacher KL distance. The first finding validates our claim, and the second finding motivates a practical rule for token-level teacher selection.
blocks.zh: 先前的一些工作(Wang等,2026c;Hao等,2026;Xu等,2026b; Ke等, 2026; Wei等, 2026; Wang等, 2026a; Li等, 2026; Han等, 2026a) 探索了选取符号进行后期训练(例如,专注高强度活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性 为此,我们开展了一项教师干预试点研究(第4节),以量化象征性的教师偏好。 如图2所示,我们保留一个学生生成的前缀,允许候选老师在选定的符号位置生成一个简短的续作,然后返回控制给学生完成响应. 这种“学生-教师-学生”接力优于纯学生一代的准确性,是教师偏好这一象征性职位的代名词。 巨额收益意味着为这一职位提供相容的老师,而小额收益则表明相反的情况。 有趣的是,结果很简单,但明确和有说服力。 首先,教师的喜好因不同而不同,即使在同样的响应中也是如此. 第二,在象征性的层面上,多数投票产生一批可靠的教师,最受欢迎的教师总是表现出很大的学生-教师KL距离。 第一个发现证实了我们的主张,第二个发现激励了象征性教师遴选的实用规则.

blocks.en: Based on these findings, we propose Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-Distillation (MTA-OPSD), the first token-level adaptive OPSD method. As shown in Figure 3 , MTA-OPSD constructs a multi-teacher pool consisting of candidate teachers, by varying the truncation strategy and exposure ratio of the privileged reference. During training, rather than using a fixed teacher for all tokens in the same response, each token adaptively selects its own teacher from the multi-teacher pool based on its preference, through majority voting followed by KL-based selection. Our token-level adaptive OPSD design is simple yet effective, precisely addressing the student-teacher mismatch. By assigning each token its preferred teacher, MTA-OPSD provides a more balanced learning signal rather than an overly sharp, rigid teacher distribution from a single teacher. We evaluate MTA-OPSD on mathematical reasoning benchmarks using models from the Qwen3 family ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , and it consistently outperforms existing OPSD approaches with an average gain of up to + 5.9 +5.9 over the base model.
blocks.zh: 基于这些调查结果,我们提议采用多教师适应政策自我调整(MTA-OPSD),这是第一个象征性的适应性OPSD方法。 如图3所显示的,MTA-OPSD通过改变优等参考的截取策略和曝光率,建立了一个由候选教师组成的多教师人才库。 在培训期间,不使用固定的教师来做同一种反应中的所有标志,每个标志都根据自己的偏好,通过多数投票,然后以KL为基础的选择,从多教师人才库中根据自己的偏好自选自己的老师。 我们的标志级适应性OPSD设计简单而有效,准确地解决了学生和教师的不匹配. MTA-OPSD通过给每个标志指定其首选的老师,提供了一个更加平衡的学习信号,而不是一个单一老师过于尖锐而僵硬的老师分布. 我们利用Qune3家族的模型(Yang等,2025年)对MTA-OPSD进行数学推理基准评价,它的业绩始终高于现有的OPSD方法,平均收益可达+ 5.9+5.9。

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • We quantify the teacher preference across tokens via a teacher-intervention pilot study, validating that preferred teachers can differ from token to token within the same response. We further reveal that the token-level preferred teacher can be identified through majority voting and KL-based selection. • We propose MTA-OPSD, the first token-level adaptive OPSD method. By constructing a multi-teacher pool as the supervision source, our approach enables each token to adaptively select its preferred teacher under the guidance of majority voting and KL divergence, effectively addressing the student-teacher mismatch. • We conduct extensive experiments across various models on mathematical reasoning tasks, demonstrating that our approach achieves superior reasoning performance compared to existing OPSD methods. Furthermore, we empirically analyze comprehensive ablation studies, paving the way for future advances in this field.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 On-policy Distillation and On-Policy Self-distillation
blocks.zh: 2.1 政策上的分散和政策上的自我分散

blocks.en: Knowledge distillation ( Hinton et al., 2015 ) transfers knowledge from a large teacher model to a student model by training on the teacher’s soft output distributions. Early approaches ( Kim and Rush, 2016 ; Jiao et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2020 ) leveraged it to sequence-level distillation, establishing the dominant off-policy distillation approaches. ( Gu et al., 2024 ; Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Lu and Lab, 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026b ) extended it to On-policy Distillation (OPD), addressing the exposure bias ( Bengio et al., 2015 ) mismatch by shifting the training distribution to the student’s own generations.
blocks.zh: 知识分馏(Hinton等,2015年)通过对教师软输出分布的培训,将知识从大型教师模式转移到学生模式. 早期方法(Kim and Rush, 2016;Jiao等人, 2020;Wang等人, 2020)利用它进行序列级分馏,建立了主导性的政策外分馏方法. (Gu等人,2024年;Agarwal等人,2024年;Lu and Lab,2025年;Yang等人,2026年b)将其扩展至On-political Dispilation(OPD),解决了曝光偏差(Bengio等人,2015年)不匹配的问题,将培训分配转移到学生自己的几代人身上.

blocks.en: Despite the rapid progress of OPD, the paradigm relies on a separate, typically stronger teacher model, which may be unavailable or expensive to maintain. To address this challenge, OPSD ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; Hübotter et al., 2026 ; Shenfeld et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026a ) removes this requirement by instantiating the teacher and student from the same model. Under this setting, the teacher and student share the same model, but the teacher is granted access to a privileged reference unavailable to the student.
blocks.zh: 尽管业务发展办公室取得了迅速进展,但这一模式依赖于一个单独的、典型的更强大的教师模式,这种模式可能无法使用或维持费用昂贵。 为了应对这一挑战,OPSD(赵等,2026;Hübotter等,2026;沈费尔德等,2026;罗等,2026;杨等,2026a)通过将师生从同一种模式中即时化而去除这一要求. 在这种背景下,教师和学生分享同样的模式,但教师可以使用学生无法使用的特权参考。

blocks.en: However, recent studies ( Kim et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Kaur et al., 2026 ; Harne et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026 ) reveal a persistent mismatch in OPSD. In particular, a highly informative reference can induce an overly sharp teacher distribution and create a mismatch between the teacher’s supervision and the student’s learning dynamics. These observations motivate the line of research for adaptive OPSD methods.
blocks.zh: 然而,最近的研究 (Kim等,2026;Wang等,2026b;Kaur等,2026;Harne等,2026;Shen等,2026)揭示了OPSD中持续存在的不匹配. 特别是,一个信息丰富的参考材料可以引起教师分布过于尖锐,造成教师监督和学生学习动态不匹配。 这些观测推动了适应性OPSD方法的研究。

blocks.en: 2.2 Adaptive On-Policy Self-distillation
blocks.zh: 2.2 适应性政策上的自我消化

blocks.en: Adaptive OPSD seeks to align the teacher supervision with the student’s learning dynamics. Rather than exposing the complete privileged reference, existing methods ( Tan and Hong, 2026 ; Han et al., 2026b ; Yang et al., 2026c ) control its content or exposure ratio using mechanisms such as learned reference-exposure schedules. By varying the amount of privileged references available to the teacher, these methods aim to avoid overly sharp supervision while retaining the benefits of dense learning signals.
blocks.zh: 适应性的OPSD旨在使教师监督与学生的学习动态保持一致。 现有方法(Tan and Hong, 2026;Han等, 2026b;Yang等, 2026c)与其披露完全特权参考,不如使用所学参考-曝光时间表等机制控制其内容或曝光比率. 通过改变教师可获得的特权参考数量,这些方法旨在避免过于尖锐的监督,同时保留密集学习信号的好处.

blocks.en: However, these methods adapt at the response level, where all tokens in the response share the same teacher and the same privileged reference. In contrast, we identify that each token needs its own teacher as tokens have distinct teacher preferences ( Section 4 ), and further propose our token-level multi-teacher adaptive OPSD method.
blocks.zh: 然而,这些方法在反应层面有所适应,反应中的所有标志都具有同一个老师和同样的特权参照。 反之,我们发现每个标志都需要自己的老师作为标志(第4节),并且进一步提出我们标志级的多老师适应性OPSD方法。

blocks.zh: 3 序言

blocks.en: 5 Method
blocks.zh: 5 方法

blocks.en: Based on the findings in Section 4.2 , we propose Multi-Teacher Adaptive OPSD (MTA-OPSD), a simple yet effective framework for token-level adaptive OPSD. As illustrated in Figure 3 , rather than using a single teacher, MTA-OPSD constructs a multi-teacher pool consisting of candidate teachers conditioned on different variants of the privileged reference. Through majority voting followed by KL-based selection, it assigns each token its preferred teacher. This ensures that different tokens within the same response receive supervision from their respective teachers.
blocks.zh: 基于第4.2节中的调查结果,我们提出多教师适应性OPSD(MTA-OPSD),这是一个简单而有效的象征性适应性OPSD框架. 如图3所显示的,MTA-OPSD没有使用一名教师,而是建造了一支多教师人才库,由以特殊参考的不同变体为条件的候选教师组成。 通过多数投票,然后根据KL进行挑选,它分配每个标志其首选的老师。 这确保同一反应中的不同标志得到各自教师的监督。

blocks.en: 5.1 Multi-teacher Pool
blocks.zh: 5.1 多教师人才库

They differ from each other only in the privileged references on which they are conditioned: R = { r 1 , r 2 , ⋯ , r K } , R=\{r_{1},r_{2},\cdots,r_{K}\}, (8) which leads to the next-token distribution of each teacher as: p T k = p θ ( ⋅ ∣ x , r k ) . p_{T_{k}}=p_{\theta}(\cdot\mid x,r_{k}). Guided by the pilot study in Section 4 , MTA-OPSD performs token-level adaptive teacher assignment in two steps: (1) majority voting identifies a reliable subset of teachers, and (2) KL-based selection chooses the preferred teacher from that subset.

blocks.en: As shown in Section 4.2 , majority voting provides a reliable teacher subset by identifying the direction of the advantage signals. We therefore use majority voting as the first step of teacher selection.

blocks.zh: 5.4 讨论情况

blocks.en: The mechanism of our method can be understood as decoupling the reliability of the supervision direction from the informativeness of the supervision signal. Majority voting first determines whether the teacher pool collectively supports or opposes the student-generated token y i y^{i} , KL-based selection then identifies the most informative teacher aligned with that direction. This ordering is crucial: KL distance is not used as a standalone measure of teacher quality, but only after directional consensus has filtered out potentially unreliable teachers.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法机制可以被理解为将监督方向的可靠性与监督信号的信息性脱钩. 多数投票首先决定教师池是集体支持还是反对学生生成的符号 y y i i i},基于 KL 的选取,然后确定与该方向一致的最富有信息的教师. 这一命令至关重要:KL距离不是作为教师质量的单独衡量标准,而是在方向共识过滤出可能不可靠的教师之后。

Meanwhile, the selected teacher can also provide a substantially different overall probability distribution. Consequently, the supervision can strengthen the sampled token without being limited to simply imitating it, thereby retaining informative probabilities for other plausible predictions and potentially reducing overfitting to the student’s current trajectory.

blocks.en: When V M ​ ( c i ) = − 1 V_{M}(c_{i})=-1 , the majority teachers assign a lower probability to y i y^{i} , and the sampled token is collectively regarded as a less preferred choice. In this case, a teacher with a small KL distance may only weakly downweight this token or remain too close to the student distribution. In contrast, the farthest teacher is more likely to redistribute probability mass toward different candidate tokens, providing a stronger corrective signal together with more distinct alternative prediction directions. Such supervision may therefore help the student move away from a potentially erroneous local choice rather than merely making a marginal adjustment to it.

blocks.en: Baselines. blocks.en: Implementation Details. All baselines and our method use dataset-provided ground-truth reference solutions as the privileged information, and all contexts include both the reasoning trace and the final answer. We use identical training and evaluation settings across all methods, with maximum generation lengths of 4096 tokens during training and 38912 tokens during validation. The multi-teacher pool contains seven teacher configurations: {full reference, prefix- 0.5 0.5 , prefix- 0.75 0.75 , suffix- 0.5 0.5 , suffix- 0.75 0.75 , random-span- 0.5 0.5 , random-span- 0.75 0.75 } 4 4 4 The truncation strategy determines which part of the reference is retained. For example, prefix truncation with an exposure ratio of 0.5 0.5 retains the first half of the reference. The final answer is retained under every truncation setting to ensure a fair comparison. . We train each method for 300 steps, evaluate checkpoints every 50 steps on the test set, and report its best Avg@12 results.

These results outperform existing OPSD methods. For individual benchmarks, MTA-OPSD also achieves or matches the best result on nearly every model-benchmark combination. Note that the improvements are particularly consistent and strong on the more challenging AIME25 benchmark. These results highlight the importance of token-level adaptive teacher assignments. A qualitative comparison is provided in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 表5列出了现有OPSD方法和我们的方法之间的全面推理性能比较. 对于平均性能而言,MTA-OPSD在每个模型尺度上均能实现最高平均性能,比起基准型号,Wen3-1.7B的平均改进为+5.9+5.9,Quen3-4B的改进为+1.5+1.5,而Quen3-8B的改进为+2.8+2.8. 这些结果超过了现有的OPSD方法. 就单个基准而言,MTA-OPSD还实现了或匹配了几乎所有模型-基准组合的最佳结果. 请注意,在更具挑战性的AIME25基准方面,改进特别一致和有力。 这些成果突出了象征性的适应性教师任务的重要性。 附录D提供了定性比较。

blocks.en: Effect of the Multi-Teacher Pool. We first investigate whether the multi-teacher pool provides more effective supervision than any individual teacher. In Table 8 , we compare our method with training using each teacher configuration from the pool independently. Although the effectiveness of individual teachers varies from each other, MTA-OPSD achieves the highest score on both average and individual benchmarks. These results suggest that the multi-teacher pool offers diverse, sufficient, and complementary learning signals.
blocks.zh: 多师子池之效. 我们首先调查多教师人才库是否比任何教师都提供更有效的监督。 在表8中,我们用独立组合的每个教师组合将我们的方法与培训进行比较。 虽然个别教师的效能各有不同,但MTA-OPSD在平均和个人基准上都取得了最高分. 这些结果表明,多教师人才库提供了多样、充足和互补的学习信号。

blocks.en: Effect of Token-Level Teacher Assignment. The multi-teacher pool is accompanied by the token-level adaptive teacher assignment. The previous ablation establishes the value of the former, but does not isolate the contribution of the latter. We therefore retain the same multi-teacher pool and compare MTA-OPSD with two alternative assignment strategies: (1) Random teacher selection from the pool for each token, and (2) averaging the distillation losses from all teachers. As shown in Table 8 , MTA-OPSD consistently outperforms both alternatives on every benchmark. These show that the gains do not arise solely from multiple teachers; selecting a suitable teacher for each token is critical to using the teacher pool effectively.
blocks.zh: 托肯级教师任务的效果。 多教师人才库配有象征性的适应性教师任务. 之前的衰减确定了前者的价值,但并不孤立后者的贡献. 因此,我们保留同样的多教师人才库,并将MTA-OPSD与两个备选任务战略进行比较: (1)从游泳池中随机挑选每个标志物的教师,并(2)平均从所有教师中分馏损失. 如表8所显示的,MTA-OPSD在每一基准上都一贯优于两种替代品。 这表明,这些收益并非完全来自多位教师;为每种标志物挑选合适的教师对于有效利用教师人才至关重要。

blocks.en: Teacher-Assignment Dynamics. We also investigate how frequently each teacher is selected throughout training. The assignments are distributed relatively evenly across the teacher pool, indicating that the selection mechanism does not collapse to a single dominant teacher. We also observe that, under the same truncation strategy, a higher reference-exposure ratio does not necessarily produce a larger student-teacher KL distance, as discussed in Appendix E . This observation further suggests that existing adaptive methods of adjusting reference exposure alone cannot determine teacher suitability.
blocks.zh: 教师分配动态. 我们还调查每名教师在整个培训过程中被挑选的频率。 这些任务在教师队伍中分布相对均匀,表明选拔机制不会倒塌给单一的主导教师. 我们还注意到,根据同样的缩短战略,较高的参考-接触比率不一定产生更大的学生-教师KL距离,附录E对此进行了讨论。 这一意见还进一步表明,现有调整参考照射的适应性方法本身不能决定教师是否合适。

blocks.en: Effect of Majority Voting and KL-Based Selection. MTA-OPSD selects a teacher in two steps: majority voting and KL-based selection. Table 8 presents the contribution of each step, where the second row is our default setting. MTA-OPSD consistently outperforms all variants, further validating the effectiveness of our design: majority voting first identifies a reliable teacher subset, and KL-based selection chooses a teacher from that subset.
blocks.zh: 多数表决和以KL为基础的选择的效果。 MTA-OPSD分两个步骤选择一位教师:多数投票和基于KL的选择. 表8列出每一步骤的贡献,其中第二行是我们默认设置。 MTA-OPSD一贯超越所有变体,进一步验证了我们设计的有效性:多数投票首先确定一个可靠的教师子集,基于KL的选择从该子集中选择一名教师.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We present MTA-OPSD, the first token-level adaptive OPSD method. A teacher-intervention study shows that teacher preferences vary across tokens and motivates our two-step token-level adaptive teacher selection strategy: majority voting with KL-based selection. Future work may explore self-evolving teacher pools and more stable multi-teacher training.
blocks.zh: 我们提出MTA-OPSD,这是第一个象征性的适应性OPSD方法. 一项教师干预研究显示,教师的喜好因标志而异,并激励我们两步标志级的适应性教师选择战略:多数人通过基于KL的选择投票。 未来工作可探索自主发展教师人才库,更稳定的多师培训.
